name: Empyrean × Mythmaker × Dark Cosmic Jhin Announcer (Beta)
creator: dear-agony
description:
### Overview

This mod replaces League's default announcer with a custom announcer composed entirely of voice lines from Empyrean, Mythmaker, and Dark Cosmic Jhin.

Voice lines were adjusted and remapped to better fit League's announcer system.

---

### Empyrean & Mythmaker & Dark Cosmic Jhin announcements

*(original League announcements → Jhin voice lines)*

**General**

• Welcome to Summoner's Rift → And now, the curtain rises. *(Empyrean)*   
• 30 seconds to minions spawn → The stage is set. *(Empyrean)*       
• Minions have spawned → Let's start the show. *(Empyrean)*   

• Summoner disconnected → It's so difficult to work under these conditions. *(Empyrean)*         
• Summoner reconnected → Places everyone, places! *(Empyrean)*  

• Victory → Art springs eternal. *(Dark Cosmic)*   
• Defeat → But, is it… art? *(Dark Cosmic)*

**Objectives**

• Your team destroyed a turret → The beauty of destruction. *(Mythmaker)*  
• Your team destroyed an inhibitor → The final chapter begins! *(Mythmaker)*

• Your turret destroyed → Art is worth the pain. *(Empyrean)*  
• Your inhibitor destroyed → Beauty is pain. *(Empyrean)*  

• Your inhibitor respawn → I feel inspired. *(Empyrean)*  
• Your inhibitor respawning soon → The composition needs something. *(Empyrean)*  

• Enemy inhibitor respawn → The show never ends! *(Empyrean)*  
• Enemy inhibitor respawning soon → Every element must be in place. *(Empyrean)*  

**Combat**

• Ally slain → Existence, is agonizing. / An echo of timelessness. *(Dark Cosmic)*  
• Enemy slain → Feel the tension build! / This scene is to die for. / Each scream is poetry! *(Mythmaker)* 

• You have slain an enemy → How magnificent. / Marvelous! / Torn to pieces! *(Mythmaker)*  
• You have been slain → But… how does it… feel? / This is the road to paradise. *(Dark Cosmic)*   

• Shutdown → Mmph. Such sweet release. / Swallow your pride. *(Mythmaker)*     
• Executed → You were… superfluous. *(Mythmaker)*           
• Ace → Erasure is perfection. / Erasure is the pinnacle of art. *(Dark Cosmic)*  

**Multikills**

• First Blood → One! *(Mythmaker)*          
• Double Kill → Two! *(Mythmaker)*  
• Triple Kill → Three! *(Mythmaker)*           
• Quadra Kill → Four! *(Mythmaker)*  
• Penta Kill → Now this is a proper show! *(Dark Cosmic)* 

**Killstreaks**

• Killing Spree → Art in application! *(Dark Cosmic)*  
• Rampage → How radiant! *(Dark Cosmic)*  
• Dominating → Transcendent. *(Dark Cosmic)*  
• Unstoppable → How close you are to divinity. *(Dark Cosmic)*  
• Godlike → Divine inspiration! / Heavenly. *(Dark Cosmic)*  
• Legendary → There is a certain elegance, in annihilation. / Space sings only for you! *(Dark Cosmic)* / I… will make you a legend! *(Mythmaker)*
